note: §0's `matches(a, b, s)`: authority granted to a key is exercisable by the key that succeeded it. This is the whole point of the relation — a principal's authority survives a key change without anybody re-issuing anything. The verifier agrees, offline, from the bundle alone: it re-walks the citation at the citing event's own seq and reports `0 cut`, and `1 resolved to a pinned root` when the reader has pinned the endorser — which is the half a kernel test cannot show.

kind.description: A one-field resource, so an authority vector has something harmless to admit.

lines.endorsements: 1 chains cited across 1 admissions; 1 resolved to a pinned root; 0 cut
